Liz K: Drafting internal announce for tomorrow's release - need quick eyes on release notes/snippet and pin. Target window: Tue 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC. Can we hold a 30m change window and a 2h rollback window? :eyes:
Sam R: LGTM on copy, push the snippet below. also call out the experimental reranking change so CS knows to watch examples.
Maria P: Can we pin the model to rwi-model@v2.4.1? If not, fallback to v2.3.9 (safer) until we confirm perf.
Alok D: +1 on pin to v2.4.1. Rollback criteria proposal: 5% error-rate delta OR latency p95 > 350ms sustained for 10m.
Eva M: Canary plan: 30m on Dedicated US-West (10% traffic), then 1h ramp. If canary fails, auto-fallback to v2.3.9 and abort rollout.
ops: @oncall please confirm standby for 3 hours post-deploy. ops will pick up second shift.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: release/2026-03-24-1800 -> canary -> prod. Canary window: 30m. Link: https://deploys.redwood/release/3123456789
Liz K: Updated internal snippet (for Slack + email):
```
Heads up: We will be rolling out model serving improvements (rwi-model@v2.4.1) on Tue 24 Mar 18:00 UTC. Expect a brief 30-minute change window. Applications will automatically fallback to rwi-model@v2.3.9 if the canary detects regressions. Please monitor dashboards and open a ticket if you see anomalies. Runbook: #eng-oncall -> ops.
```
Liz K: Draft release notes (short):
- Model reranking: improved shortlist quality on retrieval tasks
- Latency improvements: p99 down ~12% on short prompts
- Config change: default prefix cache TTL reduced to 2m (can be overridden)
Please confirm copy + pin decision.
Sam R: :thumbsup: copy looks good. call out that embeddings unaffected.
Maria P: Approved. I'll update canary configs and watch logs.
Alok D: I'll own rollback checks and trigger if thresholds hit.
ops: Standby confirmed. Pager rotation: @oncall (Maria P) -> @ops.
Liz K: Thanks all — I'll post the internal announce 45m before window and update the pinned release note doc. :wave:
